Nepal Flood Damage Estimated Over $5 Billion, Seeks International Aid

Nepal has estimated the damage from a recent flash flood, described as a "tsunami from the Himalayas," to be upwards of $5 billion. The nation is appealing to other countries for financial assistance to help with the recovery efforts. The scale of the disaster has prompted international attention, with discussions about potential impacts and aid.
